Proof in the paper: The interplanar spacing of the lattice fringes is 0.214 nm, corresponding to Pd1Co1 (111) plane of face-centered cubic (fcc) phase. Formation of a bimetallic atomic alloy of Pd and Co was confirmed by both scanning transmission electron microscopy-high-angle annular dark-field imaging (STEM-HAADF) and scanning transmission electron microscopy-energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (STEM-EDX).
